title: harness.loss.v1
description: A record that an observation could not be written. It lives outside the session directory on purpose: the most likely reason an event log cannot be written is that the session directory is gone or unwritable, and a sibling file would fail for the same reason. It carries no part of the lost event -- reason, time and count only -- so that it cannot become a second event log holding what the first one deliberately refuses to hold.

reason.description: Error class, not the event. For example "open events.jsonl: permission denied".

stage.description: Which write failed. "loss" means even this file could not be written and the record reached stderr only.
